A '''Heating Nozzle''' was a component of a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flame projector]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] wrist guard mounted flame projector incorporated a Heating Nozzle that extended out past the gauntlet, wrapped in a [[Fuel/Legends|fuel line]] that terminated in a [[Fuel Jet]]. The Heating Nozzle set the expelled fuel alight, creating the weapon's jet of fire.<ref name="EGWT" />
